title.zh: 孟德尔遗传的概率 · Punnett 方格
title.en: Mendelian inheritance as probability · the Punnett square

description.zh: 每个亲本的一对等位基因在形成配子时分开、各以 1/2 的机会传下去，把双方配子的组合列成方格，就得到 1:2:1 的基因型和 3:1 的表型；两对性状独立分配时概率相乘，得到 9:3:3:1。
description.en: Each parent’s pair of alleles separates when gametes form, each passed on with chance 1/2; laying out the combinations of both parents’ gametes in a grid gives genotypes in 1:2:1 and phenotypes in 3:1, and for two independently assorting traits the probabilities multiply into 9:3:3:1.

孩子遗传到隐性病的概率
aliases.en: chance a child inherits a recessive condition

aliases.zh: 分离定律 自由组合定律
aliases.en: law of segregation and law of independent assortment

label.zh: 配子只带一份等位基因

reason.zh: 减数分裂让同源染色体分开，每个配子只得到一对等位基因中的一个；Punnett 方格边上每种配子各占 1/2 就是这么来的。
reason.en: Meiosis separates homologous chromosomes so each gamete receives just one allele of each pair; that is where the 1/2 for each gamete on the edge of the Punnett square comes from.

reason.zh: 父母双方的配子独立结合，两对基因又独立分配，所以概率可以相乘：1/2 × 1/2 得 1/4，3/4 × 3/4 得 9/16。
reason.en: The two parents’ gametes combine independently and the two genes assort independently, so the probabilities multiply: 1/2 × 1/2 gives 1/4, and 3/4 × 3/4 gives 9/16.

label.en: Seeing the phenotype changes the denominator

reason.zh: 已知后代是显性表型，问它是杂合子的概率：先划掉不可能的 aa 格，再在剩下三格里数，得 2/3——这就是条件概率，也是贝叶斯更新最简单的样子。
reason.en: Given that an offspring shows the dominant trait, the chance it is heterozygous comes from striking out the impossible aa cell and counting among the remaining three: 2/3 — conditional probability, the simplest form of a Bayesian update.
